# AI generated code cannot be submitted to this repository directly;; i.e., if you are a collaborator, you cannot commit it. It *can* be submitted in pull requests, however:

* **You** are accountable for all AI code that ***you*** command the model to produce. Any bugs in the code are your bugs.
* Your code must be license compliant.
* All AI generated code must be clearly disclosed as such. Ideally it should also include if it was entirely generated by AI and written by you
* Your code must be manually reviewed by a human maintainer prior to being submitted and can be modified to any extent. 

Failing to follow these rules **WILL** result in you being banned from the repository.
